gaps.description: Representative joint labels for reply parents, ancestry, Groups, quotation occurrences, source spans, and unique or decision-bearing contributions remain unavailable for msgloom evaluation. Residual complete-original recovery validation belongs here and in E2; A1 primary-paper acquisition is closed.
gaps.resolution_notes: In separately authorized work, build an independently annotated and adjudicated mailbox benchmark. Include incomplete histories, multiple parents, ambiguous sources, and representative clients and formats. Report labeled messages, conversations, edges, quote occurrences, and source spans by stratum; report annotation agreement and unresolved-label counts over all annotated units. Keep conversations and quote/template families separate across training, calibration, and test sets. Use known originals withheld from reconstruction input to distinguish recoverable quoted fragments from complete originals. Report exact complete-original recovery over all withheld originals, with observable quoted-content coverage separately. Semantic response-scope annotation remains with Topic04.
gaps.closed_by: synthetic/adversarial engineering validation; independent review 03 returned accepted at confidence 0.98 with zero blocking and zero nonblocking issues. See engineering-validation/audit/.

gaps.description: Preservation of unique and decision-bearing text, recovered-fragment fidelity, and end-to-end quotation occurrence-to-source-span accuracy remain unmeasured.
gaps.resolution_notes: Using E1 labels, test conversion, zoning, deduplication, packaging, and display separately across MIME alternatives, markerless quotes, nested HTML/tables, edited quotes, short fragments, and ambiguous sources. Report lost unique spans over all gold unique spans, lost decision-bearing spans over all gold decision-bearing spans, and affected messages over all tested messages. Measure source-link precision over predicted links and recall over all gold occurrence-source links, including multiple valid occurrences. Report exact boundary accuracy and token-overlap precision/recall against gold spans. Compare recovered content with withheld originals; report unsupported generated tokens over all generated tokens and recovered gold tokens over all original tokens. Output-count similarity and retained raw bytes do not establish these results.
gaps.closed_by: synthetic/adversarial engineering validation; independent review 03 returned accepted at confidence 0.98 with zero blocking and zero nonblocking issues. See engineering-validation/audit/.

gaps.description: Late-parent reconciliation, arrival-order sensitivity, correction and retraction, and stable relation or span identity remain untested.
gaps.resolution_notes: Replay E1 cases with withheld ancestors, shuffled and repeated arrivals, conflicting identifiers, and later source evidence. Compare intermediate and final states with adjudicated references. Report corrected errors over all errors made correctable by later evidence, stale inferences over all inferences requiring retraction, and unnecessary changes over all previously correct relations. Measure correction latency in arrivals and wall time. Report final-state disagreements across replay orders over all replayed cases, and broken provenance or identity mappings over all tracked spans. Keep quote-source relations separate from reply parents.
gaps.closed_by: synthetic/adversarial engineering validation; independent review 03 returned accepted at confidence 0.98 with zero blocking and zero nonblocking issues. See engineering-validation/audit/.

gaps.description: Confidence calibration and abstention remain unvalidated for reply relations and quotation-source alignment, including true roots, unavailable parents, and ambiguous alternatives.
gaps.resolution_notes: Use separate calibration and held-out test sets from E1. Select thresholds only on calibration data. For each relation type, report accepted predictions over all eligible decisions, incorrect accepted predictions over all accepted predictions, and abstentions over all eligible decisions. Report reliability bins with counts, mean confidence, and observed correctness, plus uncertainty intervals. Measure candidate recall over all gold links whose sources are available. Evaluate true-root versus unavailable-parent errors with per-class denominators, and repeat under E3 incomplete-history replay. Keep semantic-response confidence evaluation in Topic04.
gaps.closed_by: synthetic/adversarial engineering validation; independent review 03 returned accepted at confidence 0.98 with zero blocking and zero nonblocking issues. See engineering-validation/audit/.
